require that the medical examinations of proposed appoint-
ees in the Philippine Civil Service and in corporations
owned or controlled by the Government shall be subiect
to the approval of the Government Service Insurance
WHEREAS, said executive orders are no longer necessary
in view of the provisions of section 8(a) of Commonwealth
Act No. 186, as amended by Republic Act No. 660, which
read as follows:
"An employee whose membership in th. System is compulsory
shall be automatically insured on the first day of the seventh
calendar month following the month ie was appointed or on the
first day of the sixth calendar month if the date of his appoint-
ment is the first day of the month: Provided, That his medical
examination. it required, has been approved by the System".
NOw, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby repeal Executive Order No. 183 dated February
2, 1939, and Executive Order No. 74 dated August 12,
1947.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of February,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
